Cycling in Ireland

The Emerald Isle

WILD ATLANTIC ROADS

From the dramatic coastline of the Wild Atlantic Way to the quiet rolling roads of the Irish countryside, Ireland offers an unforgettable cycling experience full of freedom, discovery, and challenge.

Our tours showcase the very best of Irish cycling. Ride on quiet roads through ancient landscapes, colourful villages, rugged coastlines, and stunning mountain passes while enjoying the famous Irish hospitality, food, and culture. Whether you're looking for epic climbs, scenic endurance rides, or simply a memorable cycling holiday with like-minded riders, Ireland has something for everyone. Our tours showcase the very best of Irish cycling. Ride on quiet roads through ancient landscapes, colourful villages, rugged coastlines, and stunning mountain passes while enjoying the famous Irish hospitality, food, and culture. Whether you're looking for epic climbs, scenic endurance rides, or simply a memorable cycling holiday with like-minded riders, Ireland has something for everyone.

Ireland's unique combination of spectacular scenery, low-traffic roads, rich history, and welcoming people makes it one of Europe's most underrated cycling destinations. The Wild Atlantic coastline provides some of the most dramatic riding in the world, while inland regions offer rolling green roads, historic castles, and charming villages where cycling remains a way of life.

From the rugged beauty of Connemara and the Burren to the iconic Ring of Kerry and Wicklow Mountains, every ride offers a new adventure and unforgettable views.

What truly makes Ireland special is not just the cycling—it's the experience. ​The friendly locals, traditional pubs, rich heritage, and stunning landscapes create memories that last a lifetime.

Why Ireland?

Quiet roads with little traffic
Stunning coastal and mountain scenery
World-famous Wild Atlantic Way routes
Traditional Irish culture and hospitality
Incredible food, cafés, and local pubs
Perfect roads for endurance riding and exploration
Suitable for all levels of cyclists

Why ride Ireland?

✓ Wild Atlantic Way
✓ Connemara National Park
✓ The Burren
✓ Ring of Kerry
✓ Wicklow Mountains
✓ Historic castles and villages
✓ Traditional Irish hospitality
✓ Spectacular coastal roads

IRELAND FACTS

LOCATION

Located on the western edge of Europe, Ireland is known for its dramatic coastlines, rolling green landscapes, charming villages, and rich cycling heritage. From the rugged Wild Atlantic Way to the scenic Wicklow Mountains, Ireland offers some of the most beautiful and peaceful roads in Europe.​

CLIMATE

reland enjoys a mild maritime climate, making it an excellent cycling destination from spring through autumn. Temperatures are generally comfortable for riding, with cool mornings, pleasant afternoons, and lush green landscapes throughout the season. While the weather can be changeable, it is all part of the authentic Irish experience.

CUISINE

Irish cuisine has evolved dramatically in recent years, combining traditional recipes with high-quality local ingredients. Expect fresh seafood, artisan cheeses, hearty breakfasts, homemade breads, and world-famous pub meals. Ireland's café culture has also grown significantly, making it a fantastic destination for cyclists who appreciate great coffee and local food.

TERRAIN

Ireland offers a diverse mix of terrain suitable for all types of cyclists. Expect rolling countryside roads, coastal routes with stunning ocean views, short punchy climbs, and longer mountain ascents in areas such as Wicklow, Kerry, and Connemara. The roads are generally quiet, scenic, and ideal for both endurance riding and adventure cycling.​
